## Contract checklist

**chatSession.ts** — ✅ `mode?: ChatMode` last param · ✅ `&mode=` only when ≠ `basic` (absent already resolves to `basic` server-side, so every pre-mode caller's URL is byte-identical) · ✅ `readonly mode` — readonly *unlike* `bypass` beside it, because a system prompt is fixed at spawn.

**AgentSurface** — ✅ `SavedMeta.mode` round-trips only for `kind:'chat'` via `knownChatMode` · ✅ `spawn` param 12 + the mandatory 1–12 order comment · ✅ `chatDefault*` read **inside** the `kind==='chat'` arm, only as a fallback when the caller named none (p-n1), through a new `agentSettingsRef` · ✅ `spawnAndRegister` carries mode.

**B3** — ✅ `resumeChatSession` **and** `changeChatMode` both spawn `explicitBypass=true, bp=cs.bypass`, with `cs.model` (pos 6) / `cs.effort` (pos 10) / `cs.mode` (pos 12) · ✅ `:750-754` comment rewritten, carrying the v3.1 caveat that a *dead* session's `cs.bypass` is the last **acked** value.

**handoffToDevelop** — ✅ `preparePrompt` → `spawn(bp=false, …, explicitBypass=true, 'develop')` inheriting the plan session's model/effort · ✅ roster entry at the plan tab's index in the plan tab's pane · ✅ **spawn precedes close** (`closeSessionById` drops zero-tab panes, so closing first would delete the pane the new tab lands in) · ✅ a mint failure alerts rather than opening an unseeded Develop tab.

**B2a** — ✅ `ChatPane` feeds the composer the session truth from `:714`; the vault prop stays the segment's write-path default only.

**Verify script** — §9 ✅ new tab at the plan index, plan tab closed, WS URL carries `bypass=0` **and** `mode=develop`, echoed argv `perm=auto`, trigger reads `auto` while the project remembers `bypass`. §10 ✅ mode switch → still `auto`, now `mode=Plan`. §10b ✅ Resume → still `auto`, brief kept. §11a ✅ Attach popover open/Esc/outside-close. §11b ✅ terminal Skills picker — **not** skipped: my first selectors (`.agent-composer-bar`, "Skills") were wrong; the real ones are `.agent-composer` / "Dreamcontext Skills", and correcting them turned a false skip into 3 real passes.

## Deviations

1. **Test file name.** The plan named `tests/unit/agent-sessions-roster.test.ts`; it does not exist. The real home for `sanitizeRoster` is `tests/unit/agent-sessions.test.ts` — extended there rather than creating a second file for the same module.
2. **Two assertion bugs found and fixed in my own script**, not the product: the banner button is "Resume session", and `.chat-cmp-badge` is `text-transform: uppercase` so `innerText` returns `SOON` (now compared case-insensitively — the test is about content, not a style rule).
3. **Pre-existing defect fixed in passing.** `resumeChatSession` was calling `spawn(cs.bypass, cs.claudeId, true, 'chat')`, silently dropping model and effort to the CLI defaults on every "Session ended → Resume". P3 required touching this line; `modelForSession`/`effortForSession` fix it.
4. **`npm run verify:chat-composer`** registered now rather than deferring to the INT wave — the script is unusable without it and the entry is one line in a file no other wave-3 task touches.
